docs.title: Amazon: Account Basics
content: Customers create an Amazon account using an email address or mobile number.
Each account has a primary shipping address, a default payment method, and an order history.
Customers can manage saved payment methods, addresses, and 1-Click settings under Your Account.
Two-step verification is strongly recommended for all customer accounts.

docs.title: Amazon: Product Search and Discovery
content: Search results are ranked by relevance, customer reviews, and historical purchase signals.
Filters include department, brand, price range, customer rating, Prime eligibility, and seller type.
Sponsored results are clearly labeled and appear inline with organic results.
Personalized recommendations on the home page are based on browsing and purchase history.

docs.title: Amazon: Product Listing Pages
content: Each product detail page shows the title, price, availability, and shipping options.
Variations such as size, color, and quantity appear under the main product image.
The buy box displays the featured offer; other sellers may be available under 'Other Sellers on Amazon'.
Customer reviews, Q&A, and product descriptions help shoppers evaluate items before purchase.

docs.title: Amazon: Cart and Checkout
content: Items added to the cart are saved across sessions for signed-in customers.
At checkout, customers confirm shipping address, delivery speed, and payment method.
Tax is calculated based on the shipping address and product category.
Orders may be split into multiple shipments depending on inventory location.

docs.title: Amazon: Payment Methods
content: Accepted payment methods include credit cards, debit cards, gift cards, and Amazon Pay balance.
Customers in eligible regions can pay using bank transfers or installment plans.
Card details are tokenized and stored securely; full numbers are never displayed after entry.
Customers can set a default payment method or choose a different one per order.

docs.title: Amazon: Prime Membership Benefits
content: Prime members receive free fast shipping on eligible items, often within one or two business days.
Prime includes Prime Video, Prime Music, Prime Reading, and member-exclusive deals.
Membership is offered as a monthly or annual subscription and can be cancelled at any time.
Prime Day is an annual sales event with member-exclusive discounts across categories.

docs.title: Amazon: Shipping Options and Delivery
content: Shipping options include standard, expedited, two-day, one-day, and same-day where available.
Estimated delivery dates are shown on the product page and at checkout.
Customers can track shipments in real time under Your Orders.
Amazon Hub Lockers and Counter pickup locations offer alternative delivery options.

docs.title: Amazon: Returns and Refunds
content: Most items can be returned within 30 days of receipt for a full refund.
Customers initiate a return from Your Orders by selecting 'Return or replace items'.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically appear within 3 to 10 business days.
Some categories such as digital downloads, gift cards, and customized items are non-returnable.

docs.title: Amazon: Third-Party Seller Marketplace
content: Amazon hosts third-party sellers in addition to first-party Amazon retail offers.
Third-party listings are clearly marked with the seller's name on the product detail page.
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) lets sellers store inventory in Amazon warehouses for Prime eligibility.
All sellers must comply with Amazon's policies on product authenticity, pricing, and customer service.

docs.title: Amazon: Customer Reviews and Q&A
content: Verified Purchase reviews come from customers who bought the item on Amazon.
Reviews must follow Community Guidelines: no incentivized content, no profanity, no personal information.
Customers can vote reviews helpful or report inappropriate content.
The Q&A section lets shoppers ask questions answered by other buyers, sellers, or Amazon staff.

docs.title: Amazon: Subscribe & Save
content: Subscribe & Save lets customers schedule recurring deliveries of eligible household items.
Subscribers receive a discount that increases with the number of items in a single delivery.
Customers can change quantity, delivery frequency, or skip deliveries from Your Subscribe & Save Items.
Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time without penalty.

docs.title: Amazon: Gift Cards
content: Amazon Gift Cards are available in physical and digital formats with no fees and no expiration.
Recipients redeem cards by entering the claim code on Your Account or at checkout.
Gift card balances are applied automatically at checkout when no other balance is available.
Amazon will never ask customers to pay outside Amazon using gift card codes; such requests are scams.

docs.title: Amazon: Deals and Promotions
content: Lightning Deals are time-limited promotions with a fixed quantity of discounted items.
Deal of the Day features a single product at a deeply discounted price for 24 hours.
Coupons can be clipped on the product page and apply automatically at checkout.
Promo codes are entered manually at checkout in the gift card and promo code field.

docs.title: Amazon: Order Tracking and Status
content: Order status updates appear in Your Orders and in shipping notification emails.
Common status values include Ordered, Shipped, Out for Delivery, and Delivered.
Customers can request a delivery photo or signature confirmation for eligible shipments.
If a package is marked delivered but missing, wait 48 hours then contact Customer Service.

docs.title: Amazon: Customer Service Channels
content: Customer Service is available via chat, phone callback, and email under the Help menu.
The Help center contains self-service articles for common issues like returns and account access.
Customer Service representatives can issue refunds, replacements, and shipping credits where applicable.
Amazon will never request account passwords, full payment card numbers, or remote access to a customer's device.

docs.title: Amazon: Account Security and Fraud Prevention
content: Customers should enable two-step verification under Login & Security.
Suspicious activity such as unrecognized orders should be reported via the Report a Phishing form.
Amazon will never email customers requesting login credentials, gift card codes, or wire transfers.
Phishing emails impersonating Amazon should be forwarded to stop-spoofing@amazon.com.

docs.title: Amazon: Privacy and Customer Data
content: Amazon collects information needed to operate the store, including order history, browsing data, and device information.
Customers can review and download their personal data from the Privacy Notice and Request My Data pages.
Personalized advertising preferences can be adjusted under Advertising Preferences.
Customers in eligible regions have rights to access, correct, and delete their personal information.

docs.title: Amazon: Kindle and Digital Content
content: Kindle books, audiobooks, and digital videos are linked to the customer's Amazon account.
Purchases sync across registered Kindle devices and the Kindle app.
Customers can manage devices and content under Manage Your Content and Devices.
Most digital purchases are non-refundable after the content has been downloaded or streamed.

docs.title: Amazon: Alexa and Echo Devices
content: Alexa is Amazon's voice assistant available on Echo devices and through the Alexa app.
Customers can shop, reorder, and track packages with voice commands when voice purchasing is enabled.
Voice purchases require a registered payment method and shipping address; a confirmation code can be required for security.
Voice recordings can be reviewed and deleted under Alexa Privacy Settings.

docs.title: Amazon: International Shopping
content: Many products ship internationally with import fees deposit calculated at checkout.
Customers can shop on regional Amazon stores using the Change Country/Region link in the footer.
Currency conversion is shown when paying with a non-local card; customers may opt to pay in their card's currency.
Customs duties and import taxes are the responsibility of the customer in destinations not covered by Import Fees Deposit.
